### Abner’s Negotiations with David
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/abners-negotiations-with-david
Passage: 2 Samuel 3:9-10
Points:
- Historical transitions of governing power have often been accompanied by violence and self-serving political ambition.
- Abner turned to negotiate with David not out of true devotion to God, but to ensure his own high position.
- Joab committed treachery by murdering Abner after David had granted him peaceful safe conduct.
- David affirmed his righteous character and honor for God's law by publicly lamenting Abner's death.
- Christians must reject Abner's pattern of shifting loyalties for personal status and instead pursue the kingdom of Christ.
